Compare two coordinate reference systems without PROJ

Source: R/crs.R
geo_crs_equal.Rd

Three levels, each looser than the last, after pyproj's is_exact_same() and equals() (design section 6.4, D14):

Usage

geo_crs_equal(x, y, level = c("identical", "structural", "authority"))

Arguments

x, y

Anything geo_crs() takes.

level

One of "identical", "structural" and "authority".

Value

TRUE, FALSE or NA.

Details

  • "identical": both absent, the same string byte for byte, or the same PROJJSON object ignoring key order. zugeo's own checks use this level.

  • "structural": PROJJSON compared after dropping members that do not change coordinates ($schema, name, remarks, usages, scope, area, bbox) and treating integers and doubles alike. A string CRS that is not identical gives NA.

  • "authority": the same authority and code, from an AUTHORITY:CODE string or a PROJJSON id, with the authority's case ignored and the pairs that differ only in axis order (OGC:CRS84 and EPSG:4326) treated as one. A side with no authority and code gives NA.

NA means zugeo cannot tell without PROJ, never that the two differ.

Examples

geo_crs_equal("EPSG:4326", "EPSG:4326")
#> [1] TRUE
geo_crs_equal("OGC:CRS84", "EPSG:4326")
#> [1] FALSE
geo_crs_equal("OGC:CRS84", "EPSG:4326", level = "authority")
#> [1] TRUE
